German court halts ‘right-wing extremist’ label on AfD
item.description: In a temporary ruling on Thursday, judges in Cologne stopped Germany’s domestic intelligence agency from using the extremism designation it placed on the party in May of last year.

item.title: Explosions reported at UK air base as Iran conflict escalates
